title: Qualification Thresholds for the Wanderlane Traveller Club Tiers
content:
Qualifying points are counted for the length of the qualifying period, and each tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club sets three figures against that count: the qualifying points needed in one qualifying period to enter the tier, the qualifying points needed in one qualifying period to hold the tier again, and the number of booked journeys that qualifies for the tier instead of the points route. The annual tier review falls in the month of the year recorded against the tier, given as a number from 1 to 12.

## Schedule of qualification figures

| Tier | Entry qualifying points | Retention qualifying points | Qualifying period, calendar months | Booked journeys as an alternative | Review month |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | 0 | 0 | 12 | 0 | 1 |
| Wanderlane Silver | 12500 | 10000 | 12 | 8 | 1 |
| Wanderlane Gold | 30000 | 25000 | 12 | 18 | 1 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | 60000 | 50000 | 12 | 32 | 1 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | 110000 | 95000 | 12 | 55 | 1 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | 200000 | 175000 | 12 | 90 | 1 |

Every tier of the programme runs its qualifying period over the same 12 calendar months and is reviewed in the same month, the first of the calendar year. The tiers stand in the order Wanderlane Blue, Wanderlane Silver, Wanderlane Gold, Wanderlane Platinum, Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Ambassador, each of the entry and retention figures rising with that order.

## The entry figure is a floor, not a target

A tier's entry figure is satisfied by a count that is at least the figure shown. Two hypothetical counts illustrate the boundary at Wanderlane Gold, whose entry figure is 30000: a qualifying count of 29999 in the period is short of the figure and does not satisfy it, while a count of exactly 30000 is at least the figure and does satisfy it. The same reading applies at each of the other tiers against its own figure.

## Two figures, two questions

The entry figure answers what a member must reach in a qualifying period to arrive at a tier they do not hold. The retention figure answers what a member must reach in a qualifying period to hold that same tier again, and at every tier above Wanderlane Blue it is the lower of the two: 10000 against 12500 at Wanderlane Silver, 25000 against 30000 at Wanderlane Gold, 50000 against 60000 at Wanderlane Platinum, 95000 against 110000 at Wanderlane Titanium, and 175000 against 200000 at Wanderlane Ambassador. At Wanderlane Blue both figures stand at 0.
